items.text: the studio's library in Instruments: the glass and textures (Fracture's voices, written as recipes) and a drum kit that arrives as a groove (kick on the beat, snare on 2 and 4, hats on eighths, the rest ready to switch on)

Instruments opens Fracture sets too: each glass voice the set has on plays here, at its level. Save as a set writes your instruments in the same format, so Fracture and Pullula can open it and keep what they don't use
2 and 4, a backbeat, for sounds on the beat

Instruments (Pro, open in beta). Bring in sounds made in Pullula: a sound, a mix, saved mixes or a pack. Each one plays by touch (tap to strike, hold to sustain), on the beat, as a bed under everything, or from the pattern, where the drawing becomes the sequencer. Choose when you import it and change it any time. In the sound shelf: instruments
the sparkle on new buttons is calm now: half the size, beside the button instead of on it, with softly rounded points. It pulses twice when it appears and then holds still
a sparkle now lasts until eight newer features have arrived, not two releases. Pro features in beta keep their open padlock instead, and get no sparkle

Sticker, a fourth Capture mode next to Still, Video and GIF. A PNG with a clear background: the field seen through the duck-rabbit, with a white or black frame or none, and the app's name or a QR code under it if you like. Pick it in the shelf under Capture
a tiny sparkle in a button's top right corner when it does something new. It shows only if you used Current before, and goes once you've used that button (or after two releases)
dragging the dice sideways sets how much each roll changes (right for more, left for less). How often it rolls lives in its shelf below, now in seconds, beats or bars
the flow reading (flow ×1.6) shows in the caption at the top like every other reading, not in a pill in the middle of the stage

turning the sound off is a four-second fade. A bar the height of the Sound button rises above it and drains like a volume bar coming down, and you hear the sound fade with it. Tap the round arrow at its top to keep the sound on, or tap the button again for off at once. On is still one tap
on a computer, the keyboard shortcuts work again (since 0.29.23 every key stopped at an error)
pressing a button on the bar no longer nudges its little path dots toward it and back
the source shelf with only picture, video and camera has no empty space on its right
the close × of the update note sits at its right edge when What's new is open
the captions at the top ("sound stays on", "zoom 120%"…) wear the same rounded dark frame, height and place as the update note and the Sound / Reset chip

the frame tool's buttons glide instead of jumping. Reset, center, level, 100%, the steps and the turns ease the drawing to its new place, taking the short way round, and the current reacts underneath as it moves. Touching the stage stops the glide where it is

after dictating or another app's sound, the Sound button checks that the sound really came back before saying so. If it is still silent, the chip stays and Reset becomes the white button. On a phone it also claims the sound back from the system first
on an iPad, the bug button sits in the top right corner, and the report opens there too
the path marks under the bar are small dots off each button's lower right: a filled dot with the path's number while it's open, a ring with a tiny tick once it's walked
when the sound comes back, the Sound / Reset chip says "Sound back" itself and then goes

coming back to Current while the sound kept playing in the background no longer kills it. The sound is checked first and only rescued if it really stopped, and only a tap (not a drag on the stage) restarts it. When the sound dips (dictating in another app) and comes back by itself, the Sound / Reset chip now goes away on its own
